title: Delgado remote-controls a bull with a brain implant

tellings.quote: implanting putting an implant in the head of a bull and basically being able to remote control a bull

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes an experiment by the scientist Jose Delgado in Spain in the 1960s. He says Delgado put an implant in a bull's head and could then control the bull by remote. He tells it as an example of how early scientists learned to steer a living brain from outside.
